caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #144: TACITURN

taciturn (adjective): saying very little; reserved.

✅ In a sentence: The taciturn farmer answered most questions with a nod.
✅ Similar: reticent, quiet, uncommunicative
✅ Remember it: Opposite: garrulous, loquacious.
